info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Campaign Management API enables businesses to enhance marketing strategies by updating customer campaign details based on specific parameters. This API allows users to modify existing campaigns efficiently, ensuring that marketing efforts align with changing customer needs. Typical consumers include marketing teams and campaign managers looking to personalize outreach. By leveraging this API, organizations can optimize their customer engagement initiatives with timely updates.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer campaign identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide the necessary information for the update, and validate the structure of the request body as per the defined schema.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to update an existing customer campaign management entity with specific changes. Ensure that only the necessary fields are included in the request, as this operation is designed to partially modify the resource.

200.description: The request was successfully completed and the resource has been updated.
